title: Worldseed is fully made by Claude Opus 5.5 over the past weeks, hope you like the game!
author: niklasdaking
selftext:
# 🌍 Worldseed Is Officially Out Now!

# The Adventure Begins!

I'm excited to announce that **Worldseed is officially released and playable right now on itch.io!**

Worldseed is a retro-inspired, open-world fantasy adventure built around exploration, discovery, and the freedom to forge your own path.

I've been working on bringing this fantasy world to life, and I'm happy to finally share it with everyone!

# 🎮 Play Worldseed Now!

Ready to begin your adventure? You can play Worldseed directly in your browser!

[**🌍 Click here to play Worldseed!**](https://generic-king.itch.io/worldseed)

# 🌲 A World Waiting to Be Explored

In Worldseed, there's a whole world waiting beyond the horizon.

Travel through forests, wander across rolling hills, discover medieval settlements, and stumble upon mysterious ancient ruins.

There isn't just one path to follow. The world is yours to explore, and where you go is entirely up to you.

# ✨ What Can You Expect?

* **🌍 Open-World Exploration** Discover a fantasy world at your own pace. Take your time, wander freely, and see what awaits beyond the horizon.
* **🏰 Mysterious Locations** Explore ancient ruins, strange monuments, and forgotten places scattered across the world.
* **🌲 Beautiful Landscapes** Venture through forests, hills, and medieval environments, each contributing to the atmosphere of the world.
* **🎮 Retro-Inspired Graphics** Experience an old-school fantasy atmosphere with a nostalgic low-poly visual style.
* **🧭 Freedom to Explore** Follow your curiosity, explore new places, and create your own adventure.

# 🚀 The Journey Starts Here

Releasing Worldseed is an exciting milestone for me, and I'm really happy to finally put it into the hands of players.

Whether you spend your time wandering through the forests, exploring mysterious locations, or simply enjoying the atmosphere, I hope you find something to enjoy.

This launch also gives me an opportunity to hear what players think and learn how I can make the experience even better.

# 💬 Your Feedback Matters!

I'd love to hear what you think of Worldseed!

If you give the game a try, feel free to leave a comment sharing your experience.

* What did you enjoy the most?
* Did you discover anything interesting?
* Did you encounter any bugs or issues?
* What would you like to see in the future?

Every bit of feedback helps, and I really appreciate everyone who takes the time to check out the game.

# ❤️ Thank You for Your Support!

Thank you to everyone who gives Worldseed a chance.

I'm excited to finally share this world with you, and I hope you enjoy exploring it as much as I've enjoyed creating it.

**🌍 Your world awaits.**

**Play Worldseed:** [**https://generic-king.itch.io/worldseed**](https://generic-king.itch.io/worldseed)

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
So, it's pretty bad.

 \- Where's the adventure hook? The cliché of 'you wake up, you don't remember' is not the worst thing, but it has to be a cost being paid in exchange for a clear benefit. Where's the benefit? 

The opening sequence to The Bourne Identity has to be your north star for that cliché, IMHO. If we're going to risk boring the player with yet another amnesiac, then we should immediately push that motherfucker off of a cliff to get things rolling so they forget about how bored with this trope they're supposed to be

 \- Or maybe don't use that cliché? New Vegas has an amazing adventure hook; CoD: Modern Warfare has an amazing adventure hook; Skyrim has an amazing adventure hook (so does Oblivion, for all that game's problems). I am not going to get excited about your world when step 1 is slowly following some fckn guy with a walking stick into his boring ass village and then doing nothing.

 \- 'It's a slow-paced open world' is not an excuse to bore the player. Skyrim is, or can be, slow-paced. Red Dead is, or can be, slow-paced. New Vegas is, or can be, slow-paced. Etc., etc. There is a difference between slow pacing and pure boredom. 

 \- The character menu is atrocious. One single column layout crammed with play instructions, no organization to the different functions and no relevant information at the tip of the players' fingers. Please, look at any other RPG game's menu system and see how information is organized and partitioned. 

 \- Having nothing to do at the start of the game isn't just boring; it's a missed opportunity to teach the player the game's mechanics. If there were stuff to do at the start, the game could walk you through doing it and then you don't really need to cram the character menu with instructions.

replies.author: niklasdaking
replies.body:
I guess that is all fair, I sort of think a bit here is the world, now you make the adventure was fun to me, but that is probably my downfall, it seems like some sort of action and onboarding is needed and that is fair.

regarding the menu yes! I am working on this right now, it has just not been the most important thing yet, but you are right, it is one of the things a player will see, and if it looks bad, well.. then it looks bad no matter what I say

replies.author: AsparagusOk8818
replies.body:
Okay, if it's supposed to be just 'here is the world, now you make the adventure', then cut out the walking stick guy and the introductory text altogether. There's no equivalent to the walking stick guy or the introductory text in Don't Starve or Minecraft. 

Having the design be 'here is the world, now you make the adventure' is totally fine, but in that case the player needs clear and immediate goals that then organically lead to other goals. The environment should be less busy, so all of the interactables are noticeable and inherently enticing.

A good version of that kind of game should always be visually leading the player around by offering them a breadcrumb trail to chase that is likely to lead them to something super interesting / super dangerous.

We should not use assets think ”math”, perline noice, ray casting, anything goes, make it as complex as you want as long as the output is clean, simple, easy, beutiful. We need bioms and seeds, we need random and we can have procedural generation, think hard and deep and ask for follow-ups”
